entities.name: The Three
entities.description: Planeswalkers Ugin, Sorin Markov and Nahiri who allied to imprison the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Planeswalker and mastermind of the trio.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker in The Three, guardian of Zendikar.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titans imprisoned on Zendikar by the Three.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's home plane where the Eldrazi were trapped.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: Mountains of Zendikar where the Eldrazi were confined.

events.summary: The Three decided to force the Eldrazi titans into physical forms and trap them on a sacrificed plane.
events.quote: They decided to force the Eldrazi titans into physical forms and trap them on a plane

events.summary: They agreed to return if the ritual was disturbed, and departed; Nahiri served as Zendikar's guardian for centuries.
events.quote: For centuries, Nahiri served as Zendikar's guardian

relations.quote: Ugin was the mastermind of the trio
